# QuotaPin 2.0.0-beta.1

This beta starts the 2.x placement architecture while v1.2.0 remains the stable Latest release.

- Pick the account row, title center, either side of the composer, or a safe slot inside the composer from a visual work-surface map.
- Move the quota rail independently between the account row and the composer bottom edge.
- Store semantic zones instead of screen coordinates; unavailable or ambiguous host surfaces fail closed to the account row.
- Keep the native avatar, account name, Codex short click, and QuotaPin hold gesture attached to the original account surface.
- Migrate schema 17 settings to schema 18 without moving an existing layout.

The beta is publishable only after isolated product gates, a local hot-update acceptance that preserves the running Codex process, and explicit prerelease approval. It must not be marked Latest.

## Beta install paths

Windows 10 version 2004 or later:

```powershell
& ([scriptblock]::Create((irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WSL043/QuotaPin-for-Codex/main/install.ps1))) -Version '2.0.0-beta.1'
```

The reviewed Windows package is `QuotaPin-2.0.0-beta.1.exe`.

macOS:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WSL043/QuotaPin-for-Codex/main/install-macos.sh | bash -s -- --version 2.0.0-beta.1
```

The reviewed macOS package is `QuotaPin-macOS-2.0.0-beta.1.dmg`.
